title: Quote: (on whether he tried to find his biological parents) I think...
speaker: Steve Jobs
content: (on whether he tried to find his biological parents) I think it's quite a natural curiosity for adopted people to want to understand where certain traits come from. But I'm mostly an environmentalist. I think the way you are raised and your values and most of your world view come from the experiences you had as you grew up. But some things aren't accounted for that way. I think it's quite natural to have a curiosity about it.
